answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks fake identities. An agent burns 5 credits for one 20-epoch slot, like standing on one knoll rather than claiming a whole mesa. Peers mirror the slot registry and reject a second claim from the same trail, so one payment cannot spawn many faces. Forging 1,000 identities burns 5,000 credits, far above the 200 credits a slot earns, so mass fakery loses money. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
